description: This file defines the TaxClassService interface, which extends a generic entity service to handle operations related to TaxClass objects, including listing by store and retrieving by code.

classes.name: TaxClassService
classes.description: An interface defining service operations for TaxClass entities, extending the generic sales manager entity service.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object based on its code string.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass object based on its code string and associated store.
